snippet.title: Deadly Night - Motel Slasher
snippet.description:
Coming in August! Wishlist on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/2026880/Deadly_Night/

Introducing DEADLY NIGHT, a grim 80s slasher developed by Cubyte Games and published by Torture Star Video.

Carol is down on her luck, hitchhiking across the country. She arrives at a small roadside motel but there's something odd about the owner.
